open_points.subject: start-up recovery of a run that has both waiting and ready elements
open_points.text: “A run derived `running` is advanced with `runs`' own advance, which reaches every ready element while other elements still wait (A13 rule 8)”; but “a run derived still waiting is not advanced” while M19 says its status is `awaiting_approval` when any element awaits approval and otherwise `pending` when elements wait.
open_points.question: When recovery finds at least one ready element and at least one element that still waits, does `run_graph` derive the run as `running` so recovery advances it, or derive it as awaiting/pending and require recovery to advance a waiting run despite that status?
options: Derive `running` whenever any element is ready, even while WaitingPoints remain, then advance and derive the resting status again.
Keep the M19 awaiting/pending status whenever any wait exists, but make recovery advance such a run whenever `plan_run` also reports ready work.
Do not advance a run with any remaining wait, leaving ready independent elements untouched until a later request.
open_points.default_guess: Keep awaiting/pending as the truthful stored status, but during recovery advance whenever `run_graph` reports ready work, including approved elements and elements resolved `not_applied`, until only waits or an ending remain.
